segments.name: Developing novel therapies
segments.description: A preclinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel therapies for severe autoimmune and inflammatory disorders, including gastrointestinal and inflammatory lung diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through a single operating and reportable segment focused on the business of developing novel therapies to treat severe autoimmune and inflammatory disorders with the mission to develop life-changing therapeutics for patients.
